summary: Trump states a nuclear deal with Iran may be reached today while threatening massive strikes if talks collapse; Israeli forces conduct systematic operations across Gaza and southern Lebanon, demolishing Hezbollah tunnels and striking multiple villages; a tanker reports an explosion off Yemen's coast as regional tensions escalate.
key_points: Trump says Iran deal possible Wednesday 14 Mordad, warns Hormuz Strait will open soon or face massive attack (Source: @mamlekate/104080)
Senior Iranian official tells Al Jazeera only one or two issues remain for nuclear agreement (Source: @yediotnews25/133622)
IDF Chief of Staff says forces systematically hitting Hamas in Gaza, will continue defending communities (Source: @idf_telegram/24839)

Israeli strikes hit multiple southern Lebanon villages including Tebnine (1 dead, 11 wounded), Al-Burj Al-Shamali, Majdal Zoun, Al-Mansouri, Ali Al-Tahir, Arnoun (Source: @redlinkleb/34948, @redlinkleb/34928, @redlinkleb/34953, @manniefabian/58933, @redlinkleb/34945, @redlinkleb/34956, @New_security8200/203214)
Hezbollah tunnel in Srebbine demolished by 300th Baram Brigade and Yahalom unit; Kfir Brigade and Kiryati reservists find weapons caches (Source: @manniefabian/58922)
Netanyahu vows Israel will prevent Iranian nuclear weapon with or without deal (Source: @kianmeli1/90664)
US lifts sanctions on Iraqi airline Fly Baghdad linked to IRGC Quds Force, owner sanctions remain (Source: @VahidOnline/77758)
UKMTO reports attack incident 95NM southeast of Aden, Yemen; tanker hears loud explosion (Source: @shin_persian/8839)

sections.executive_summary: Trump declares a nuclear deal with Iran may be finalized today while threatening unprecedented military action if Tehran backs out, stating the Hormuz Strait will open soon. Israeli forces are conducting simultaneous high-tempo operations in Gaza and southern Lebanon, including systematic strikes on Hamas, demolition of a Hezbollah tunnel in Srebbine, and artillery and air strikes on at least six Lebanese villages causing casualties. A maritime attack off Yemen adds a naval dimension to the multi-front escalation.

points: Trump states a deal with Iran may be reached Wednesday 14 Mordad, says negotiations are going well but Iran refuses to acknowledge them, warns Hormuz Strait will open soon or face a massive attack larger than any since WWII, claims US was prepared to strike before Iran asked to talk (Source: @VahidOnline/77752).
Senior Iranian official tells Al Jazeera only one or two issues remain to reach a nuclear agreement, indicating negotiations are in final stages (Source: @yediotnews25/133622).

US Treasury lifts sanctions on Iraqi airline Fly Baghdad previously designated for cooperation with IRGC Quds Force, though sanctions on owner Bashir Abdulqadir Alwan Al-Shabani remain in place (Source: @VahidOnline/77758).

Mohammad Baqer Kharazi, secretary-general of Hezbollah Iran, accepts denial by Mojtaba Khamenei's office regarding alleged warning to President Pezeshkian but hopes the denial holds after 'important future changes' in leadership offices (Source: @VahidOnline/77755).

President Pezeshkian condemns adversaries who oppose 'any symbol that helps us gain and stay independent and creative,' stating they do not desire capable individuals in leadership (Source: @presstv/201723).
IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Herzi Halevi tours Gaza, states forces are systematically hitting Hamas and will continue defending Israeli communities from the front (Source: @idf_telegram/24839).
Prime Minister Netanyahu declares Israel will continue actions to prevent Iran from obtaining nuclear weapons whether through agreement or without one (Source: @kianmeli1/90664).
IAF drone strikes target in Arnoun village, southern Lebanon (Source: @New_security8200/203214).

sections.threat_assessment: The convergence of imminent nuclear diplomacy deadlines with multi-front kinetic operations creates a highly volatile environment. Trump's explicit linkage of Hormuz Strait access to nuclear compliance introduces a maritime choke-point threat that could trigger immediate escalation. Simultaneous Israeli operations in Gaza and southern Lebanon at increased intensity, combined with Hezbollah's tunnel infrastructure degradation and weapons cache discoveries, suggest a coordinated campaign to degrade Iranian proxy capabilities ahead of potential diplomatic breakthroughs or breakdowns. The Yemen maritime incident adds a naval dimension that could draw in international forces.
sections.regional_response: Iran's negotiating posture appears to be reaching a critical juncture with only final issues unresolved, while its proxies absorb significant degradation in Lebanon. The US sanctions relief on Fly Baghdad signals calibrated diplomatic engagement despite ongoing kinetic pressure. Arab Gulf states face direct threats to maritime commerce via Hormuz and Red Sea routes. Israel's dual-track strategy of maximum military pressure alongside diplomatic openness creates strategic ambiguity for adversaries. Lebanese state institutions remain marginalized as Hezbollah infrastructure is systematically targeted.
sections.intelligence_notes: The mistaken IDF interceptor launch in southern Lebanon reveals operational friction in dense battlespace management. The evacuation order for Al-Mansouri suggests Israel is shaping the battlefield for deeper incursions. The Nineveh Plain warning indicates ongoing Iranian-backed militia vulnerability to Saudi or Israeli strikes in Iraq. The Arrow system test demonstrates continued Israeli missile defense readiness amid multi-axis threats. The UKMTO incident off Aden may reflect Houthi capability retention despite Yemeni government drone upgrades. Internal Iranian power dynamics around Mojtaba Khamenei's office warrant monitoring for succession signals.
